newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian Jan electricity demand down 0.2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Italian Jan electricity demand down 0.2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Italian electricity consumption fell 0.2 percent to 23 billion kWh in January compared with January 1996, utility company Enel said on Thursday.
Provisional data showed demand stagnating after taking into account the different number of days worked in both months.
Consumption in the intermediate industrial goods sector fell, reflecting lower demand in sectors such as construction materials and stagnation in the chemicals sector, Enel said.

Electricity demand by the finished goods sector showed a moderately positive trend but Enel pointed out that a drop in demand in the construction sector "which has been going on for several years and is taking on a structural character."
Net national production in January was 19.8 billion kWh, down 0.6 percent on the year.
